profile.ja: 魔界に棲息する人造生命体。高度な科学技術によって製造されたとみられるが、詳しいルーツは不明。頭部の感覚器で様々な波長の電波を観測し、物質の内部構造を容易く透視することが可能である。初めは野山で魔物を観察していたが、更なる刺激を求めて都市へとやってきた。元々は人間からかけ離れた身体の形状を取っていたが、現在は環境に適応する為、人型に擬態している。触手から出る分泌液の成分はコントロール可能で、それらの成分から様々な化学物質を精製することも出来るようだ。好奇心旺盛で日々刺激の強い文化や食物を求めて盛り場を練り歩いている。悪食であり、捕食の対象は無機物、有機物を問わない。
profile.en: She is a synthetic life form that inhabits the Demon Realm. Although she appears to have been manufactured using advanced technology, her exact origins are unknown. Her head is equipped with sensory organs that allow her to observe various wavelengths of electromagnetic waves, making it possible for her to easily see through the internal structure of objects. Initially, she observed demons in the wilderness, but she came to the city in search of more stimulation. Originally, her body had a shape that was far removed from that of humans, but she has since adapted to her environment by disguising herself as a human. The secretions from her tentacles can be controlled, and she can refine various chemicals from these secretions. She is curious and seeks out strong stimuli, culture, and food every day, wandering around the city's entertainment districts. She is an omnivore, and her prey is not limited to organic or inorganic matter.

text.ja: やっほー、アンタイトだよ。きみと一緒にいるとおもしろそうだからついてくことにする！　うん、ケッテーだね！
text.en: Yeah, I'm Antite! I'm gonna follow you because it looks like we're gonna have some fun together! Yeah, it's a deal!

text.ja: うーん、ぼく……？　どの生物がベースだとか、自分でもルーツはわかんないんだよね。だからぼちぼち探しながら旅してるんだ
text.en: Hmm, me...? I don't even know what kind of creature I'm based on or where I come from. That's why I'm traveling around, searching for answers.

text.ja: ああ、頭のこれ？　これはヒューマンでいう髪じゃなくて感覚器、センサーってやつかな。これで色んなことがわかるんだ
text.en: Oh, this thing on my head? It's not hair, it's a sensory organ, like a sensor. It helps me understand all sorts of things.

text.ja: わぁ～、やっぱ都会はすごいな！　色んな種がいて、キラキラしててぎすぎすしてて騒がしい！　観察が楽しいよ！
text.en: Wow, the city is amazing! There are so many different species, and it's all shiny and bustling! I love observing it all!

text.ja: この外骨格ね、苦労してヒューマンのカタチに近付けてみたんだ。触手は残しとかないと生きてけないから仕方ないね～
text.en: This exoskeleton, I had to work hard to get it to resemble a human shape. I had to keep the tentacles, though - I wouldn't be able to survive without them.

text.ja: 服……？　ああ、そういえばヒューマンはみんな服を着てるね。発情期になっても見えないけど、どうやって見分けてるのかな？
text.en: Clothes...? Oh, right, humans wear clothes all the time. Even when they're in heat, you can't tell - I wonder how they can tell the difference?

text.ja: ん、好き嫌い？　ぼくはなんでも食べるから……あ！　山で採れるこの鉱石はおいしいよ！
text.en: Likes and dislikes? I'll eat anything, so... Oh, and this ore I found in the mountains is delicious!

text.ja: 頭の感覚器で観測すると、けっこうどんな物質でも内部の構造を透視できるんだよ～。おもしろいよ♪
text.en: If I use my head's sensory organs to observe, I can see the internal structure of almost any material. It's really interesting!

text.ja: これがヒューマンの雄の生殖器官……チンポ。ああっ、大きくなった！　これって他の種でも見られるけど、勃起だね！
text.en: This is a human male's reproductive organ... a penis. Ah, it's getting bigger! This is something you can find in other species too, but it's an erection!

text.ja: ぼくは違う種とも交配できるんだよ♪　ほらこれ、ヒューマンのマンコ。マン汁も出るしチンポを気持ちよくすることもできるんだよ～
text.en: I can mate with different species, you know! Look, this is a human vagina. It can produce lubrication and stimulate the penis too!

text.ja: ヒューマンと交わるの初めてだけど……ものすごく気持ちいい！　ああんッ！　マンコの中を擦られるのクセになるよ！
text.en: This is my first time with a human, but... it feels incredibly good! Ahh, the friction inside the vagina is addictive!
